description: Color sorting: colored goal cups accept only their matching candy-color marble (mismatch rolls over a closed lid — no fail states); a waiting marble at the chute previews the next drop (tap to cycle in sandbox); puzzle levels 7–9 use scripted color sequences solved by collecting every color; the sandbox palette gains a tap-to-cycle color cup. Board schema v2 with lossless v1 migration; code-driven visuals, no new dependencies or assets; verified by unit tests, scripted e2e level solves, and the 4-viewport matrix + reliability gate.
